text:
alex.m: FYI — ops ping: who is allowed to push to prod during the midnight change window? We had an unexpected deploy last week and need to clarify roles.

maria: Only people in the 'deployers' org group and anyone listed in the 'release-leads' SSO role can prod-deploy. MFA required per policy. Runbook: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/prod-deploy

charles: Need a short-term delegation for @jordan (oncall relief). How do we grant without giving full deployer membership?

sophie: Use the delegated role flow: `/grant-prod-access @jordan duration=4h approvers=@maria,@alex.m reason="oncall handoff"` — this creates an audit entry. It enforces MFA and 2FA session.

alex.m: Is the 2-approver requirement flexible in emergencies? Last rollback was delayed by approvals.

eng-release-oncall: Not for regular patches. For P0 emergency we have an emergency pre-approve list (see infra policy). We can add SRE oncall to that list for the window but it requires RFC + audit trail.

maria: I'll open a short RFC and tag @security. Also proposing a nightly 'deployer' rota so we don't rely on ad-hoc delegation.

deploy-bot: Deploy attempt blocked — user @external-contractor tried to run `/deploy prod v2026.03.19-hotfix` — DENIED: user not in allowed groups. Audit ID: ADT-2026-0456.

charles: That's the contractor that was given temp access weeks ago; who approved that? We need to revoke.

sophie: Revoked temporary role ADT-2026-0420. Contractor removed from 'delegated-deployer'. Also created short-lived 'nightly-deployer' group with 1h session and forced device MFA. Will post membership list in #eng-sre.

alex.m: Thanks. Can we automate adding the oncall to the rota for weeks they are scheduled? saves manual grants.

maria: Yes — will add automation ticket. For now, follow delegated role flow. If you need me to approve @jordan tonight, ping here.

charles: pinged maria, approved. Proceeding with hotfix once deploy window opens. :thumbsup:
